commands.name: R1-mb40
command:
import json,runpy,sys
from pathlib import Path
c=json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text());o=Path(c['output']);assert not(o/'report.json').exists();n=runpy.run_path('scripts/benchmark-flash-bridge.py');n['run'].__globals__['PROMPTS']=c['prompts'];old=n['validate'];gold=json.loads(Path('docs/measurements/sushi-20261027/gold-AR-MAIN.json').read_text())
def checked(event,mode,mtp,budget,*args):
 old(event,mode,mtp,budget,*args)
 assert event['token_hash']==gold['token_hash'] and event['cache_context']==gold['cache_context'],'golden mismatch'
 m=event['stats']['memory'];assert 0<m['process_footprint_bytes']<=12_000_000_000 and 0<m['process_lifetime_peak_bytes']<=12_000_000_000,'physical footprint'
n['run'].__globals__['validate']=checked
n['run'](Path(c['engine']),Path(c['model']),o,mtp=False,tokens=128,repeats=c['repeats'],cache_gib=3,timeout=180)
